zh: 添加词语时「释义」两个字不再竖着排成两行，窗口变窄时两个释义框改为上下排列。侧栏收窄成图标栏时，底部三个按钮不再被挤出栏外。状态筛选条与测验页的方向选择在放不下时可以横向滑动，不再被切掉一半。
en: The definition label no longer stacks its two characters vertically when adding a word, and the two definition fields now sit one above the other on a narrow window. The three footer buttons stay inside the sidebar when it collapses to the icon rail. The status filter strip and the quiz direction picker scroll sideways when they run out of room instead of being cut in half.
